# FlossChart

> FlossChart turns a photo into a printable cross-stitch pattern with DMC floss colors, in the web browser. The photo never leaves the device. Free preview and free floss list for every size; charts up to 40 x 40 stitches print free; bigger charts (up to 500 x 500 stitches) need a one-time unlock of 5.00 EUR via PayPal. No account, no subscription.

## The free tool

- [FlossChart, English](https://floss.toolkitsdesk.com/): upload a photo, set width in stitches (20 to 500) and number of DMC colors (2 to 60), confetti cleanup (off, normal, strong), Aida 11, 14, 16 or 18 count, print or download a PDF with symbols, floss list and skein estimates.
- [FlossChart, Deutsch](https://floss.toolkitsdesk.com/index.de.html)
- [FlossChart, Français](https://floss.toolkitsdesk.com/index.fr.html)
- [FlossChart, Español](https://floss.toolkitsdesk.com/index.es.html)

## Facts

- Color data: 489 DMC six-strand floss colors from craft-color-codes by MakeBead (https://github.com/makebead/craft-color-codes), CC BY 4.0. Screen colors are approximations of real thread.
- Finished size: stitches / fabric count = inches. 140 stitches on 14 count = 10 inches (25,4 cm).
- Skein estimate: about 1.800 full stitches per skein on 14 count with 2 strands, waste included.
- FlossChart is not affiliated with DMC. DMC is a trademark of its owner.
- Seller and contact: see the imprint (https://floss.toolkitsdesk.com/imprint.html). Support: support.toolkits.desk@gmail.com.
